scope: Calls 0-3 of locked recurrent trace; contract is export/runtime input, output, state, transition, threshold, and packaging policy only. No export is implemented by this file.

qwen2_backbone.decision: retain accepted INT8 Qwen2; no new quantization

connectors_diffusion_decoder_semantic.decision: retain FP32 audio path; FP16 is not this ABI

representation.choice: one fixed-capacity method per audio component plus explicit phase and valid-length vectors
representation.reason: Avoids shape-specialized methods and phase-specific weight copies. Calls 0-3 are warm-up: decoder cache 28 is only 4/15 full after call 3 and all transpose caches first have full pre-context at call 15.
representation.phase_semantics: zero-based recurrent call index; phase 0 is reset/cold; only phase+1 is a legal next transition
representation.padding: All cache tensors have fixed capacity. Valid values are left-aligned; padding is canonical +0.0 and is neither read nor propagated as context.
representation.fallback_policy: If fixed-capacity slicing cannot be exported faithfully, host validation MUST reject. Do not substitute shape-specific warm-up methods or change this frozen ABI without a reviewed ABI revision.

reset_and_state_rules.reset: Set phase=0; allocate all 68 fixed-capacity cache tensors as FP32 canonical zeros; set both valid-length vectors to 34 zeros. Qwen state resets independently per its frozen INT8 ABI.
reset_and_state_rules.legal_commit: Run acoustic_decode and then semantic_encode with the same phase. Validate every output before atomically replacing both state sets and incrementing phase.
transition_rejection: phase is not the controller phase
any length is negative or exceeds its cache capacity
length vector differs from the predeclared phase 0-3 vector during this four-call validation
input cache content changes during execute
reset_and_state_rules.mutation_guard: Hash or byte-compare every input cache before/after execute. Methods are pure: cache state changes only through named next-cache outputs. On any failure discard every output and retain the complete prior state.
reset_and_state_rules.aliasing: Input and output cache storage MUST NOT alias. No in-place writes, hidden module buffers, or runtime-owned persistent cache state are permitted.
reset_and_state_rules.post_call_3: phase=4 is the four-call validation boundary, not steady state. The same fixed-capacity representation can continue, but extension beyond call 3 is outside task-13 acceptance. Full transpose pre-context begins only at call 15.

packaging.audio_artifact: one inline-constant multi-method PTE containing acoustic_decode and semantic_encode; each audio parameter stored once
packaging.qwen_artifact: retain the accepted INT8 Qwen2 artifact/ABI; do not merge or requantize it in this task
packaging.constant_duplication_policy: No phase-specific method or PTE may duplicate decoder/semantic weights. The exporter must report PTE bytes and compare parameter payload/duplicate storage against the two single-method baselines; any duplicate full parameter copy is a rejection.
packaging.external_constants: Not used: ExecuTorch 1.2 can write PTD and a private host loader can run it, but public host Runtime.load_program and Android Module.load expose no PTD/data-loader path.
packaging.capability_basis: The synthetic probe supports inline multi-method shared constants. It does not prove VibeVoice export; task 13 must measure actual duplication.

global.deterministic_repeat: exact selected tokens and exact output/cache SHA-256 on repeated reset-and-four-call host runs

qwen_int8.selected_token: exact equality on every call (primary INT8 correctness gate)
qwen_int8.comparison: against the locked eager FP32 trace, with max absolute error reported separately for hidden, logits, and each of 56 caches; no allclose claim
qwen_int8.rationale: Predeclared bounds narrowly above existing accepted Android INT8 observations (hidden 0.5756, logits 0.4436, aggregate cache/output 1.208). Exceeding a bound rejects rather than widening it.

fp32_boundaries.rule: Every element and every cache must pass its named threshold; thresholds are component-scoped and MUST NOT be silently widened.

pcm_s16.comparison: round/encode both host output and locked eager reference with the same signed-16-bit path, then compare every aligned sample

chunk_energy_dbfs.rule: Chunk 3 must be within 3 dB of the locked voiced reference, have at least 1023 S16 peak units, not clip, and also pass the per-sample PCM gate. Chunks 0-2 must each be within 3 dB of their locked reference; silence/fade-in is expected, not a failure.

perceptual_protocol.prompt: Using only aligned chunk 3 (0.400-0.533 s), confirm audible speech-like voiced onset rather than silence, a steady tone, broadband noise, click-only output, or a dropout.
perceptual_protocol.pass_definition: Listener records speech_like_voiced_onset=true and all five excluded outcomes=false. This is an audibility/non-speech gate, not an intelligibility, naturalness, speaker-identity, or full-quality rating.
perceptual_protocol.failure_policy: A numerical pass cannot override this gate, and a perceptual pass cannot override any numerical gate. Record pending_user_review only after host/device evidence exists; never invent a rating.
